items.title: Effectiveness of a Structured Post-Platelet Rich Plasma Rehabilitation Approach on Pain and Function in Subacromial Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A 21-day structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach, added to standard physiotherapy, significantly improved pain (VAS: 9.00 ± 0.67 to 2.92 ± 1.14 vs. 9.11 ± 0.64 to 7.96 ± 0.75, p < 0.001) and function in 27 subacromial pain syndrome participants compared to standard physiotherapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 结构化康复方案与 PRP 联合使用对肩峰下疼痛综合征有短期益处，尤其是在疼痛缓解、肌力、活动度和功能方面。将其视为标准疗法之外的潜在补充，但要注意尚无长期随访数据。
items.titleZh: 结构化 PRP 术后康复方案对肩峰下疼痛综合征疼痛与功能的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 21 天的随机对照试验显示，在标准物理治疗基础上增加结构化 PRP 术后康复方案，在肩峰下疼痛综合征患者中显著改善疼痛（VAS 从 9.00 ± 0.67 降至 2.92 ± 1.14，对照组从 9.11 ± 0.64 降至 7.96 ± 0.75；p < 0.001）和功能，共 27 名受试者参与。
items.curatedReasonEn: A structured rehabilitation approach combined with PRP shows short-term benefits for subacromial pain syndrome, particularly in pain relief, muscle strength, range of motion, and function. Consider it a potential adjunct to standard therapy, but note the lack of long-term follow-up data.
items.limitation: 本研究的随访期仅为 21 天，无法评估长期效果和改善的可持续性。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was only 21 days, preventing assessment of long-term effects and sustainability of improvements.

items.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Treatment Planning in Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review found 9 studies showing Large Language Models (LLMs) have promising capabilities in supporting rehabilitation treatment planning, with concordance rates up to 98.75% with expert opinion, though "hallucinations" were reported.
items.curatedReason: 大型语言模型（LLM）在康复治疗计划中展现出前景，能与专家意见保持高度一致，尤其在肌骨和心血管康复领域。你可以关注其在辅助个性化方案制定上的潜力，但需警惕“幻觉”现象，人工监督仍不可或缺。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在物理和康复医学治疗计划中的作用：一项系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述纳入 9 项研究发现，大型语言模型（LLMs）在康复治疗计划中展现出前景，与专家意见的一致性可达 98.75%，但需注意其潜在的“幻觉”问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in rehabilitation treatment planning, aligning well with expert opinions, especially in musculoskeletal and cardiovascular rehab. Monitor their potential for assisting personalized plan development, but be aware of "hallucinations"; human supervision remains essential.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量有限，且 LLM 存在“幻觉”问题，仍需高质量研究验证其在实际康复中的有效性和安全性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies and the issue of LLM "hallucinations" mean that high-quality research is still needed to validate their real-world effectiveness and safety in rehabilitation.

items.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study of 8,533 pediatric rehabilitation referrals found only a 42.7% service initiation rate, with barriers including geographic availability, scheduling, communication, and financial challenges, varying by patient characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 这项混合方法研究揭示了儿童康复服务依从性低（仅 42.7%）背后的复杂障碍，包括地理可及性、排班困难、费用、交通以及专业人员与家庭沟通不畅等。应关注这些因素，以提高服务启动率并减少社会人口学差异。
items.titleZh: 从转诊到现实：儿科康复服务启动障碍的混合方法分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8,533 份儿科康复转诊的混合方法研究显示，服务启动率仅为 42.7%，障碍包括地域可及性、排班、沟通和财务挑战，并因患者特征而异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This mixed-methods study reveals complex barriers behind low pediatric rehabilitation service initiation rates (only 42.7%), including geographic availability, scheduling difficulties, cost, transportation, and poor communication between professionals and families. Addressing these factors is crucial for improving service initiation and reducing sociodemographic disparities.
items.limitation: 这项研究来自单一的儿科医疗机构，其结果可能存在地域性和系统性局限，不一定能完全推广至其他医疗系统或更广泛的地理区域。
items.limitationEn: This study was conducted within a single pediatric healthcare organization, and its findings may have geographic and systemic limitations, potentially not fully generalizable to other healthcare systems or broader regions.

items.title: Learned helplessness is associated with jump-landing biomechanics following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
items.summary: In 33 individuals post-ACLR, greater learned helplessness was moderately associated with greater peak knee abduction in the ACLR limb (r = 0.564, p = 0.001) during jump-landings, accounting for 34.8% of variance.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，ACL 重建术后的“习得性无助”心理状态可能与动态膝关节外翻力学改变有关。除了关注体能恢复，也应将心理和神经行为因素纳入康复和重返运动评估中，可能有助于改善生物力学结果和降低再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 习得性无助与前交叉韧带重建术后跳跃落地生物力学相关。
items.summaryZh: 对 33 名前交叉韧带重建术后个体研究发现，在跳跃落地时，较高的习得性无助感与重建侧肢体更大的峰值膝关节外展角度中度相关（r = 0.564, p = 0.001），解释了 34.8% 的方差。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that learned helplessness after ACLR may be associated with altered dynamic knee abduction mechanics. Beyond physical recovery, psychological and neurobehavioral factors should be integrated into rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessments to potentially improve biomechanical outcomes and reduce re-injury risk.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量相对较小（33 人），且仅为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，也无法推断习得性无助随时间变化的趋势。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (33 participants) and a cross-sectional design, precluding causal inference and the ability to track changes in learned helplessness over time.

items.title: Individualized systems-informed corrective exercise for adults meeting prespecified criteria for upper crossed syndrome: protocol for a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This is a protocol for an RCT (n=36) to evaluate the added effect of an individualized, systems-informed corrective exercise program for adults with upper crossed syndrome, focusing on postural angles as the primary outcome over 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项针对“上交叉综合征”的随机对照试验方案，旨在验证个体化、分阶段的矫正运动方案的附加效果。该方案尝试标准化入组标准和干预内容，有助于提高研究可重复性。对肩颈姿势问题感兴趣的临床医师可以关注其后续研究结果。
items.titleZh: 针对符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人的个体化系统矫正运动：一项随机对照试验方案。
items.summaryZh: 这是一项针对 36 名符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人的随机对照试验方案，旨在评估个体化、系统知情矫正运动方案的附加效果，主要结局指标是 12 周后的姿势角度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a protocol for an RCT on "upper crossed syndrome," aiming to validate the additive effect of individualized, staged corrective exercise. The protocol standardizes eligibility and interventions, which should improve reproducibility. Clinicians interested in shoulder-neck posture issues may follow its future results.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未有实际结果数据，且其 4 周的随访期无法提供关于复发预防的长期推论。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol without actual results yet, and its 4-week follow-up period will not support long-term inferences about recurrence prevention.

items.title: First-Hand Experience and the Value of Telerehabilitation for Chronic Knee Pain: A Discrete Choice Experiment Nested in a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A discrete choice experiment nested in an RCT found that patients with prior telerehabilitation experience were willing to pay significantly more (AU$87.49) for telehealth consultations for chronic knee pain compared to those with in-person experience.
items.curatedReason: 有远程康复经验的患者明显更愿意为慢加性膝关节疼痛的远程医疗咨询付费，AU$87.49 的支付意愿差额印证了这点。打算拓展远程医疗服务的同行们请注意，实际使用经验才是提升患者接受度和支付意愿的关键。
items.titleZh: 慢性膝痛远程康复的亲身体验及其价值：一项随机对照试验中的离散选择实验
items.titleEn: First-Hand Experience and the Value of Telerehabilitation for Chronic Knee Pain: A Discrete Choice Experiment Nested in a Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summaryZh: 一项嵌套在随机对照试验中的离散选择实验发现，有远程康复经验的患者更愿意为慢性膝痛的远程医疗咨询支付费用（高出 87.49 澳元）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides evidence that prior experience with telerehabilitation significantly increases willingness to pay for it. This finding is important for providers considering expanding or adopting telehealth services for chronic knee pain, suggesting patient acceptance is linked to actual use.
items.limitation: 离散选择实验依赖假设情景，可能无法完全反映真实世界中的选择。
items.limitationEn: The discrete choice experiment relies on hypothetical scenarios, which may not perfectly reflect real-world choices.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Comparison of robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training on balance and gait outcomes in patients with stroke: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized trial comparing robot-assisted gait training (RoboGait) with visual feedback balance training (ProKin-252) in stroke patients found ProKin-252 led to significantly greater improvements in balance (BBS) and reduced fear of falling, though overall functional gains were similar between groups.
items.curatedReason: 尽管卒中患者的总体功能改善在两组中相似，ProKin-252 视觉反馈平衡训练在平衡能力（BBS）和减少跌倒恐惧方面表现出统计学上的显著优势。这提示我们，在卒中康复中，视觉反馈干预可能在特定恢复领域有微弱但可靠的领先。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练与视觉反馈平衡训练对卒中患者平衡和步态结局的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Comparison of robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training on balance and gait outcomes in patients with stroke: a randomized controlled trial
items.summaryZh: 一项比较卒中患者机器人辅助步态训练（RoboGait）与视觉反馈平衡训练（ProKin-252）的随机试验显示，ProKin-252 在平衡（BBS）和恐惧跌倒方面有更显著改善，尽管总体功能获益相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: While both robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training improved outcomes, ProKin-252 visual feedback showed a modest but statistically significant advantage in balance (BBS) and reduced fear of falling. This suggests that for patients with stroke, prioritizing visual feedback interventions might offer a slight edge in specific areas of recovery.
items.limitation: 主要结局（BBS）的微小差异以及在更广泛功能结局中缺乏显著差异，限制了观察到的优势的临床意义。
items.limitationEn: The modest difference in the primary outcome (BBS) and the lack of significant differences in broader functional outcomes limit the clinical significance of the observed advantage.

items.title:
XR serious games for phantom limb pain, neurofunctional recovery, and prosthetic adoption: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 24 studies found that XR serious games demonstrated preliminary benefits in reducing phantom limb pain (largest effect sizes with AR-based phantom motor execution systems, d = 0.9–1.3), improving functional mobility, and supporting prosthesis adoption after amputation.
items.curatedReason: XR 严肃游戏，特别是 AR 幻肢运动执行系统（d = 0.9–1.3），有望作为截肢术后幻肢痛管理、功能活动度提升和假肢适应的新辅助手段。虽然这只是初步证据，但其在疼痛干预和假肢使用训练方面的潜力值得我们关注。
items.titleZh: 用于幻肢痛、神经功能恢复和假肢采纳的扩展现实（XR）严肃游戏：一项系统综述
items.titleEn: XR serious games for phantom limb pain, neurofunctional recovery, and prosthetic adoption: a systematic review
items.summaryZh: 一项对 24 项研究的系统综述发现，扩展现实（XR）严肃游戏在减轻幻肢痛（AR 幻肢运动执行系统效应量最大，d=0.9-1.3）、改善截肢后的功能活动能力和支持假肢采纳方面显示出初步益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: XR serious games, especially AR-based phantom motor execution systems (d = 0.9–1.3), show promise as an adjunct for managing phantom limb pain, improving functional mobility, and aiding prosthesis adoption post-amputation. While preliminary, this evidence warrants attention for its potential in pain intervention and prosthetic training.
items.limitation: 神经功能和具身性结局的证据仍处于探索阶段，XR游戏的实际应用和可扩展性仍有待深入研究。
items.limitationEn: The evidence for neurofunctional and embodiment outcomes is still exploratory, and real-world implementation and scalability of XR games remain under-researched.

items.title: Timed Up and Go, gait speed, and grip strength: associations and discriminative performance for falls in community-dwelling older adults - results from the KORA-age study
items.summary: In community-dwelling older adults, the Timed Up and Go (TUG) test remained associated with falls after frailty adjustment, but neither TUG, gait speed, nor grip strength showed clear incremental discrimination beyond age and sex, and combining measures did not improve prediction.
items.curatedReason: 该研究再次确认了 TUG 测试与社区老年人跌倒之间的关联，即使调整了虚弱因素。然而，TUG、步态速度和握力在年龄和性别之外没有显示出明显的额外区分能力，并且组合这些指标也未能提高预测准确性。这表明，TUG 虽是实用指标，但单一使用不足以精准预测跌倒风险。
items.titleZh: timed up and go、步速和握力：与跌倒的关联性及社区居住老年人的鉴别性能 - KORA-age 研究结果
items.titleEn: Timed Up and Go, gait speed, and grip strength: associations and discriminative performance for falls in community-dwelling older adults - results from the KORA-age study
items.summaryZh: 在社区居住的老年人中，调整衰弱后，Timed Up and Go（TUG）测试仍与跌倒相关，但 TUG、步速和握力均未显示出超越年龄和性别的明显增量鉴别能力，组合测量也未能提高预测性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reinforces the association between the Timed Up and Go (TUG) test and falls in older adults, even after adjusting for frailty. However, its limited incremental discriminatory power beyond age and sex suggests that while TUG is a useful marker, it may not be sufficient on its own for precise fall risk prediction.
items.limitation: 所有测试的身体表现测量均未显示出超越年龄和性别的清晰增量区分，且既定的TUG阈值在识别跌倒者方面敏感性有限。
items.limitationEn: None of the tested physical performance measures showed clear incremental discrimination beyond age and sex, and established TUG thresholds had limited sensitivity for identifying fallers.

items.title: The impact of multidisciplinary intervention under the concept of ERAS on the prognosis of frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy: a non-randomized prospective cohort study
items.summary: A non-randomized prospective cohort study found that a multidisciplinary ERAS-based intervention for frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy led to lower postoperative complication rates (P=0.043), shorter hospital stays (7.1 vs. 10.5 days), and improved functional recovery (6-minute walk test) compared to conventional care.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究表明，针对虚弱老年胃切除术患者的多学科 ERAS 干预能显著降低术后并发症率（P=0.043）、缩短住院时间（7.1 对 10.5 天）并改善功能恢复。对这类脆弱人群，整合性、团队协作的围手术期护理是值得推广的策略。
items.titleZh: ERAS理念下多学科干预对进行胃切除术的衰弱老年患者预后的影响：一项非随机前瞻性队列研究
items.titleEn: The impact of multidisciplinary intervention under the concept of ERAS on the prognosis of frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy: a non-randomized prospective cohort study
items.summaryZh: 一项针对接受胃切除术的衰弱老年患者的非随机前瞻性队列研究发现，基于ERAS的多学科干预可降低术后并发症发生率（P=0.043）、缩短住院时间（7.1 vs. 10.5天），并改善功能恢复，优于常规护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that a multidisciplinary ERAS-based intervention can significantly improve outcomes for frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy, including reduced complications and hospital stay. This supports the integration of comprehensive, team-based perioperative care for this vulnerable population.
items.limitation: 本研究采用非随机化设计与历史对照，且30天再入院率差异无统计学意义。
items.limitationEn: The study used a non-randomized design with historical controls, and the 30-day readmission rate difference was not statistically significant.

items.title: Squeezing more out of less: blood-flow restriction training in COPD and other conditions, from the clinic to the home
items.summary: This commentary discusses blood flow restriction (BFR) training as a low-load resistance exercise strategy that achieves strength gains comparable to high-load training, suggesting its utility for patients with COPD and other conditions, enabling exercise from clinic to home.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论强调，血流限制（BFR）训练作为一种低负荷阻力运动策略，能达到与高负荷训练相当的力量增益。对于 COPD 及其他不耐受高负荷训练的患者，BFR 有望成为一种从诊所到家庭都可实行的有效方案，值得临床同行进一步关注。
items.titleZh: “少即是多”：从诊所到居家，COPD及其他疾病的血流限制训练
items.titleEn: Squeezing more out of less: blood-flow restriction training in COPD and other conditions, from the clinic to the home
items.summaryZh: 本文评述了血流限制（BFR）训练作为一种低负荷阻力训练策略，可实现与高负荷训练相当的力量增益，并提出其在COPD等疾病患者中的应用前景，支持从诊所到居家进行训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights blood flow restriction (BFR) training as a promising low-load resistance training method that can elicit strength gains comparable to high-load training. Its application in populations intolerant to high loads, such as those with COPD, from clinic to home, warrants further clinical attention.

items.title: Effects of Hypoxic Exposure and Training Methods on Wingate Test Performance: A Systematic Review
items.summary: A systematic review of 43 studies found acute hypoxic exposure generally does not decrease Wingate test performance unless severe (FiO2 ~0.104) or repeated; prolonged chronic exposure can reduce performance, but shorter camps do not. Intermittent hypoxic training likely benefits performance when combined with longer exercise durations.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述指出，急性缺氧暴露通常不会降低 Wingate 测试表现，除非缺氧程度严重 (FiO2 ~0.104) 或反复暴露；长期慢性缺氧可能会降低表现，但短期训练营则不会。间歇性低氧训练在结合更长运动持续时间时，很可能有利于提高表现。
items.titleZh: 缺氧暴露和训练方法对 Wingate 测试表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.titleEn: Effects of Hypoxic Exposure and Training Methods on Wingate Test Performance: A Systematic Review
items.summaryZh: 一项对 43 项研究的系统综述发现，急性缺氧暴露通常不会降低 Wingate 测试表现，除非在严重（FiO2 ~0.104）或重复情况下；长期慢性暴露可能降低表现，但短期训练营则不会。间歇性缺氧训练可能在与较长运动时间结合时有益于表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review indicates that acute hypoxic exposure does not significantly impair Wingate test performance unless severe or repeated, and prolonged chronic exposure may reduce anaerobic performance. Intermittent hypoxic training, especially with longer exercise durations, may enhance anaerobic capacity.
items.limitation: 该综述发现，高强度间歇训练可能会提高无氧运动表现，无论是否缺氧，这表明训练方式本身是关键。
items.limitationEn: The review found that high-intensity interval training may improve anaerobic performance regardless of hypoxic exposure, suggesting the modality itself is key.

items.title: Match Exposure and Estimated Travel Before ACL Injury in Professional Women’s Football: An Exploratory Within-Player Case-Crossover Study
items.summary: An exploratory case-crossover study in professional women's football found that injury seasons had slightly greater match exposure (minutes, appearances) and estimated travel distance in the 30 days prior to injury compared to matched control periods, though effect sizes were small and variability was high.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提出，在职业女子足球中，受伤前 30 天的比赛暴露（上场时间、出场次数）和预估旅行距离可能略有增加。尽管效应量小且变异性大，这些发现可为未来前瞻性研究的 ACL 损伤预防策略提供思路。
items.titleZh: 职业女子足球运动员 ACL 损伤前的比赛暴露与预估行程：一项探索性个体交叉研究
items.titleEn: Match Exposure and Estimated Travel Before ACL Injury in Professional Women’s Football: An Exploratory Within-Player Case-Crossover Study
items.summaryZh: 一项对职业女子足球运动员的探索性个体交叉研究发现，与匹配的对照期相比，ACL 损伤赛季前的比赛暴露（分钟数、出场次数）和 30 天内的预估行程稍多，但效应量小且变异性大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests that slightly higher match exposure and travel distance may precede ACL injuries in professional women’s football. While effect sizes are small and variability is high, these findings could inform future prospective research on injury prevention strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性研究，效应量小，玩家间变异性大，且未建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study is exploratory with small effect sizes and substantial between-player variability, and it does not establish causality.

items.title: CMS Extends and Modifies Nationwide Freeze on New Medicare Hospice and Home Health Enrollment for Six Months to Combat Fraud
items.summary: CMS has extended and modified the nationwide freeze on new Medicare hospice and home health enrollment for an additional six months to combat fraud.
items.curatedReason: CMS 将全国范围内针对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结延长并修改六个月。如果你在考虑开设新的安宁疗护或家庭健康服务，这表明美国监管环境收紧，短期内机会窗口关闭，需要密切关注后续政策走向。
items.titleZh: CMS 延长并修改全国范围内对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结六个月，以打击欺诈行为
items.summaryZh: CMS 已将全国范围内针对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结延长并修改六个月，以打击欺诈行为。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has extended and modified the nationwide freeze on new Medicare hospice and home health enrollment for six months. If you are considering opening new hospice or home health services, this indicates a tightening regulatory environment in the U.S. and a closed window of opportunity in the short term. You should closely monitor future policy developments.

items.title: Effects of adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy on postural responses and autonomic function in individuals with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: An 8-week RCT (n=30) found that adjunctive craniosacral therapy (CST) to conventional physiotherapy in MS patients led to greater reductions in Adaptation Test (toes-down) and Motor Control Test (back-small) latency measures (p=.034, η2=0.129; p=.006, η2=0.166, respectively), but no significant between-group differences were observed at any assessment point, nor were significant treatment effects on autonomic function detected.
items.curatedReason: 虽然颅骶疗法（CST）结合常规物理治疗可能对多发性硬化症患者的特定姿势反应参数产生影响，但本研究并未证明CST具有优于常规疗法的效果，也未对自主神经功能产生显著治疗作用。临床实践中继续以有明确证据的干预为主。
items.titleZh: 颅骶疗法联合常规物理治疗对多发性硬化症患者姿势反应和自主神经功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的随机对照试验（n=30）显示，多发性硬化症患者在常规物理治疗基础上增加颅骶疗法（CST），在适应性测试（脚尖向下）和运动控制测试（后小）的潜伏期测量中表现出更大的缩短（p=.034, η2=0.129；p=.006, η2=0.166），但未在任何评估时点观察到组间显著差异，自主神经功能也未见显著治疗效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: While craniosacral therapy (CST) combined with conventional physiotherapy may influence specific postural response parameters in MS patients, this study did not demonstrate superiority over conventional therapy or significant treatment effects on autonomic function. Continue to prioritize evidence-based interventions in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=30），且为单盲设计，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=30) and was single-blind, potentially limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Regression-Based Balance Discordance Refines Prediction of Prospective Falls After Subacute Stroke: A Secondary Analysis of the LEAPS Trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis (n=384) of the LEAPS trial found that continuous, regression-based balance discordance, particularly multivariable discordance, predicted prospective recurrent falls after subacute stroke (HR=1.27, 95% CI 1.03-1.58, p=.026), whereas a previously published threshold-based classification did not. Single-variable discordance showed a lower fall hazard (HR = 0.79, 95% CI 0.63-0.99, p = .037).
items.curatedReason: 这次对 LEAPS 试验的二次分析提示，在卒中后跌倒风险评估中，你可能需要放弃基于阈值的分类法。用连续的、多变量回归分析来衡量患者的平衡信心与客观表现之间的不一致，可能更准确地预测复发性跌倒（HR=1.27）。
items.titleZh: 基于回归的平衡不一致性可更精准预测亚急性卒中后前瞻性跌倒：LEAPS 试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: LEAPS 试验的一项二次分析（n=384）发现，连续的、基于回归的平衡不一致性，尤其是多变量不一致性，能预测亚急性卒中后的前瞻性复发性跌倒（HR=1.27, 95% CI 1.03-1.58, p=.026），而之前发布的基于阈值的分类则未能做到。单变量不一致性显示出较低的跌倒风险（HR = 0.79, 95% CI 0.63-0.99, p = .037）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis of the LEAPS trial suggests you might want to move away from threshold-based classifications for post-stroke fall risk. A continuous, multivariable regression approach to measure discordance between balance confidence and objective performance appears to predict recurrent falls more accurately (HR=1.27).
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察分析，依赖于原有随机对照试验（LEAPS）的数据，可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a secondary, observational analysis of a randomized controlled trial (LEAPS), which may be subject to unmeasured confounders.

items.title: VRCycle: A Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating a Virtual Reality Cycling Intervention in People With Knee Osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A two-arm feasibility RCT (n=41) found that both VR-enhanced cycling and traditional cycling for 6 weeks were highly feasible and acceptable for people with knee osteoarthritis, showing preliminary improvements in pain, function, and exercise capacity.
items.curatedReason: 对于膝骨关节炎患者，VR 辅助骑行和传统骑行都高度可行且可接受，能在 6 周内初步改善疼痛、功能和运动能力。VR 方案或许能增加患者运动依从性，但此为小型可行性 RCT（n=41），尚不能得出定论，期待大型试验数据。
items.titleZh: VRCycle：一项评估虚拟现实骑行干预对膝骨关节炎患者可行性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项双臂可行性随机对照试验（n=41）发现，为期 6 周的虚拟现实增强骑行和传统骑行对膝骨关节炎患者均高度可行且可接受，并在疼痛、功能和运动能力方面显示出初步改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both VR-enhanced cycling and traditional cycling are highly feasible and acceptable for people with knee osteoarthritis, showing preliminary improvements in pain, function, and exercise capacity over 6 weeks. While VR may boost exercise adherence, this was a small feasibility RCT (n=41), so don't draw firm conclusions yet; larger trials are needed.
items.limitation: 这是一项可行性研究，样本量小（n=41），不具备评估疗效的统计功效。
items.limitationEn: This was a feasibility study with a small sample size (n=41) and was not powered to evaluate efficacy.

items.title: Next-generation control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons: State-of-the-art, limitations, and future directions.
items.summary: A review of lower-extremity exoskeleton control strategies highlights current limitations in user intent detection, adaptability, and cognitive burden. It explores emerging approaches like brain-computer interfaces and nerve interfaces to enable more natural and autonomous mobility for gait rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述深入剖析了下肢外骨骼控制策略的现状与瓶颈。它为关注神经康复中机器人辅助步态训练的临床医生，系统性地梳理了技术发展方向，尤其对未来外骨骼与用户意图融合的进展有重要参考价值。
items.titleZh: 下肢外骨骼的下一代控制策略：现状、局限性与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于下肢外骨骼控制策略的综述强调了用户意图检测、适应性和认知负担方面的现有局限性。该综述探讨了脑机接口和神经接口等新兴方法，以实现步态康复中更自然、更自主的移动能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review deeply analyzes the current state and bottlenecks of lower-extremity exoskeleton control strategies. For clinicians focused on robot-assisted gait training in neurological rehabilitation, it systematically outlines technological development directions, especially regarding future integration of exoskeletons with user intent.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，基于现有文献而非原始数据，可能存在选择偏倚且无法进行定量分析。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, based on existing literature rather than original data, which may introduce selection bias and prevent quantitative analysis.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: User Experience of a Rehab Community-Based, Affordable Robot Exercise System (Rehab CARES) for Gamified Motor and Cognitive Stroke Rehabilitation
items.summary: A longitudinal study (n=6 adults with chronic stroke) on RehabCARES, a gamified robot exercise system for motor and cognitive stroke rehabilitation, reported low pain, light-to-moderate perceived exertion, strong enjoyment, and high usability scores (peaking at 86/100), indicating a positive user experience in a community setting.
items.curatedReason: 这款社区康复机器人系统（RehabCARES）的用户体验积极，证实了机器人辅助训练在卒中后运动和认知康复中的可行性与可接受性。它提示了未来社区康复模式中智能硬件的潜力，能为你的患者提供个性化且有吸引力的训练。
items.titleZh: 基于社区的经济型机器人锻炼系统（Rehab CARES）在游戏化运动和认知卒中康复中的用户体验
items.summaryZh: 一项关于 RehabCARES（一种用于运动和认知卒中康复的游戏化机器人锻炼系统）的纵向研究（n=6 名慢性卒中成人）报告称，该系统在社区环境中提供了积极的用户体验，表现为低疼痛、轻至中度感知劳累、强烈的愉悦感和高可用性评分（最高 86/100）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This community-based rehabilitation robot system (RehabCARES) received positive user experience, confirming the feasibility and acceptability of robot-assisted training for post-stroke motor and cognitive rehabilitation. It indicates the potential of smart hardware in future community rehabilitation models, offering personalized and engaging training for your patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的用户体验研究，样本量小（n=6），且缺乏对照组，无法评估其确切的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary user experience study with a small sample size (n=6) and lacks a control group, preventing assessment of definitive clinical efficacy.

items.title: Use of Rehabilitation Therapy Services among World Trade Center Health Program Members with Cancer
items.summary: This study aims to examine the utilization of rehabilitation therapy services among World Trade Center Health Program members with cancer certification between 2011 and 2024.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究（2011-2024 年数据）揭示了世贸中心健康计划中癌症患者康复服务的使用模式。它提示了特定高危人群在康复服务可及性和利用上的潜在缺口，值得我们作为政策制定者和康复服务提供者深入评估。
items.titleZh: 世贸中心健康计划癌症患者康复治疗服务利用情况
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在调查 2011 年至 2024 年间，世贸中心健康计划中患有癌症的成员对康复治疗服务的利用情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study (2011-2024 data) illuminates rehabilitation service utilization patterns among cancer patients in the World Trade Center Health Program. It signals potential gaps in accessibility and uptake for this specific high-risk population, warranting deeper evaluation from policymakers and rehabilitation providers like us.
items.limitation: 尚无摘要或全文，无法评估研究设计细节，可能存在因数据来源和人群特异性导致的局限。

items.title: A case-series exploring real-world postural behaviour change following physiotherapy for low back pain.
items.summary: A case series (n=5) using wearable sensors found real-world lumbar posture differences between pre- and post-physiotherapy days in three participants with chronic low back pain, with pain often preceded by increased end-range flexion, aligning with clinical assessment in some cases.
items.curatedReason: 这项案例系列研究通过可穿戴传感器展示了现实生活中腰痛患者的姿势行为变化。它提示了可穿戴技术在个体化姿势指导和评估中的潜力，但需要更强的研究设计来归因干预效果。
items.titleZh: 一项探索物理治疗后腰痛患者现实世界姿势行为变化的案例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项使用可穿戴传感器进行的案例系列研究（n=5）发现，三名慢性腰痛患者在物理治疗前后，其现实世界腰椎姿势存在差异，且疼痛通常由末端屈曲增加引起，部分情况与临床评估一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series explores real-world postural changes in low back pain patients using wearable sensors. It highlights the potential of wearable tech in personalized postural guidance and assessment, but stronger study designs are needed to attribute intervention effects.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（n=5）的案例系列研究，缺乏重复基线测量，无法将观察到的变化归因于物理治疗干预。
items.limitationEn: This is a small case series (n=5) lacking repeated baseline measurements, so observed changes cannot be attributed to the physiotherapy intervention.

items.title: Comparative Efficacy of Low-Level Laser Therapy in Patients With Carpal Tunnel Syndrome: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 RCTs found low-level laser therapy (LLLT) significantly reduced pain (Hedges' g=-1.524, P <0.001) and improved grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391, P=0.002) in carpal tunnel syndrome. Pulsed mode was superior for analgesia, continuous for grip strength.
items.curatedReason: 对于腕管综合征患者，明确使用 LLLT。本综述证实 LLLT 能显著缓解疼痛（Hedges' g=-1.524）并提升握力（Hedges' g=0.391）。治疗时请注意：脉冲模式更利于镇痛，而连续模式对改善握力效果更佳。
items.titleZh: 低能量激光疗法治疗腕管综合征患者的比较疗效：随机对照试验的最新系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 16 项随机对照试验的最新系统综述和荟萃分析发现，低能量激光疗法 (LLLT) 显著减轻了腕管综合征的疼痛 (Hedges' g=-1.524, P <0.001) 并改善了握力 (Hedges' g=0.391, P=0.002)。脉冲模式在镇痛方面表现更优，连续模式则有利于握力。
items.curatedReasonEn: For your carpal tunnel syndrome patients, definitely incorporate LLLT. This review confirms significant pain reduction (Hedges' g=-1.524) and improved grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391). When applying, remember that pulsed mode is superior for analgesia, while continuous mode is better for improving grip strength.
items.limitation: 不同研究间激光参数、治疗方案和评估方法存在异质性，可能影响结果的综合性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in laser parameters, treatment regimens, and assessment methods across studies may affect the generalizability of results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Physiological responses during high intensity interval training and moderate intensity continuous training in patients attending early cardiac rehabilitation.
items.summary: In 18 cardiac rehabilitation patients, low-volume HIIT elicited greater ventilatory, hemodynamic, and metabolic demands (e.g., higher mean VO₂, %HRR, blood lactate) and higher perceived exertion compared to time-matched MICT, suggesting a greater physiological stimulus.
items.curatedReason: 这项单中心随机交叉试验对比了早期心脏康复中高强度间歇训练（HIIT）与中等强度持续训练（MICT）的生理反应，明确了 HIIT 能提供更大的生理刺激，为你制定个性化心血管康复方案提供了依据。
items.titleZh: 早期心脏康复患者进行高强度间歇训练和中等强度持续训练时的生理反应
items.summaryZh: 在 18 名早期心脏康复患者中，低容量高强度间歇训练（HIIT）比时间匹配的中等强度持续训练（MICT）引起了更高的通气、血流动力学和代谢需求（如更高的平均 VO₂、%HRR、血乳酸），以及更高的感知劳累度，表明 HIIT 提供了更大的生理刺激。
items.curatedReasonEn: This single-center randomized crossover trial comparing physiological responses between HIIT and MICT in early cardiac rehabilitation confirmed that HIIT elicits a greater physiological stimulus, providing evidence for tailoring personalized cardiovascular rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（18 人），且为单中心研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (18 participants) and is single-center, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
